title: Black Ops 3 Patch Notes and Double XP
contentHtml:
Call of Duty: Black Ops III has gotten the first downloadable update today which contained a ton of Weapon Tuning and its first Double XP weekend. Let’s dive right into what the game changing side of this update contained.
General:
  • Leaderboards are now viewable in Barracks.
  • Players now receive Cryptokeys in both the ‘Arena’ and ‘Public’ matchmaking after playing consecutively.
  • Team balancing changes (improved to maintain even teams.)
  • Fixed UI error when entering Prestige for Multiplayer.
  • Addressed UI error in Fileshare when selecting an empty tab.
  • Addressed the problem where hosts were able to leave as soon as the match began.
  • Fixed issue where white boxes appeared instead of Custom Classes.
Gameplay
  • Addressed Scorestreak kills counting towards Specialist kill challenges.
  • Fixed issue where players attachments would not reset upon weapon prestige.
  • Fixed spawn issues for Free-For-All and Gun Game.
  • Addressed an issue where players could spawn after match timer had expired.
  • Search & Destroy kills have been changed from 250 to 500 XP.
  • Cerberus scorestreak can no longer be destroyed by a friendly Power Core.
  • Mothership scorestreak will no longer count towards the “Hard Counter” challenge.
  • Fixed common error messages while in matches and menus.
Specialists
  • Specialist weapons and abilities now charge at a faster pace in objective game modes.
  • Fixed text descriptions for Specialist weapon multi-kills which unlock Specialist Epic.
Outrider
     -     Vision Pulse ability recharge speed has been reduced.
Nomad
     -     Fixed an issue with the requirements for the 9th helmet.
     -     Rejack ability recharge speed has been increased.
     -     H.I.V.E trigger radius is reduced.
Reaper
     -     Scythe has had its ammo reduced to 160.
Firebreak
     -      Heatwave recharge speed has been increased.

Weapon Tuning
General
  • Longshot distance settings updated based on weapon class.
  • Fixed an issue where some damage from shotguns was being reduced while long barrel was being used.
  • Fixed launchers not earning weapon XP for destroying vehicles.
  • Quickdraw ADS speed was reduced for LMGs.
Submachine Guns
  • VMP: ADS time and hip fire spread slightly increased to match other SMGs.
  • Pharo: Close damage slightly reduced.
  • Razorback: Damage range increased.
Assault Rifles
  • KN-44: Fixed ADS view for the iron sights while having clan tag or kill counter equipped.
  • XR-2: Hip fire spread increased to match other assault rifles, minor tweak to fire rate.
  • HVK-30: Increased ability to control recoil.
  • ICR-1: Fixed animation issue when a Varix 3 Optic or Suppressor is equipped.
  • M8A7: Fire rate increased, fixed optical issue with iron sights if kill counter was equipped.
Shotguns
  • KRM-262: Increased lethal range.
  • Haymaker 12: Fire rate and damage slightly reduced.
  • Argus: ADS time and close range damage increased.
Light Machine Guns
  • BRM: ADS speed slightly reduced
  • Dingo: Increased ability to control recoil
  • Gorgon: Clip size changed to 40, ADS time slowed, no longer deals extra damage to vehicles without FMJ, increased recoil and increased hip fire spread.
  • 48 Dredge: Fixed issue with 1 bullet being left in the stockpile after all other ammo being shot, slightly reduced ADS time.
Pistols
  • L-CAR 9: Close range damage slightly reduced
Equipment
  • Thermite: Damage rate reduced, now takes longer to be killed.



Double XP is live from Thursday November 19th to Monday November 23rd at 10 AM PST.
Game on Ladies and Gentlemen.   ​
